grf_decision_trace.observed_anchor: Exact-head one-file workflow succeeded on self-hosted Linux X64, the emitted ELF was downloaded and independently executed, and the grounded inspect queries returned validated Builder Box models tied to build/pipeline/security provenance.
grf_decision_trace.hypothesis: A minimal grounded inspection slice can live inside the one-file EntityOS boundary without introducing a detached UI architecture or fabricated machine facts.
grf_decision_trace.counterhypothesis: The visual slice is only decorative/static output and does not yet constitute the required universal interactive OS surface.
grf_decision_trace.falsifier: Inspect the exact binary behavior and canonical entry path: supported queries must execute real probes/state; unknown queries must fail visibly; rendered surface must remain inside the binary; interactive launch/progressive exploration must be separately demonstrated.
grf_decision_trace.promotion_limit: Grounded Builder Box inspection is verified for the admitted slice only; whole-machine visual acceptance is not promoted.

unusual_experiment.scope_note: Performed earlier in this same go cycle on a verified EntityOS baseline; later d7d9d339 checks were ordinary verification only.

negative_results: The first local inspect invocation used an unsupported --json token after the inspect command; EntityOS correctly treated it as query text and returned UNKNOWN. Re-running the documented inspect <query> form passed for both required grounded queries.

The current inspect-html path emits a white HTML surface with an input element but does not by itself prove an interactive launched application, progressive follow-up loop, universal inspectability, or full factual-class visualization.
current_blocker: Complete and prove the universal interactive Clay surface beyond the grounded static inspect slice: actual launch/display on the accepted Ubuntu lane, live same-surface query/follow-up interaction, visibly distinct verified/measured/inferred/planned/blocked/unavailable/unknown classes, broader canonical ClayCode/EntityOS discovery, and bounded generative composition without a conventional menu hierarchy.
next_executable_action: Extend the current Builder Box slice into the smallest real interactive surface loop inside the same EntityOS file, with an accepted-host launch/display test and deterministic interaction transcript covering performance, what is a claymachine, one follow-up query, and one unsupported query. Bind every displayed fact to provenance/class metadata, validate the render model before display, then rebuild exact current head and rerun one-file workflow plus independent local verification.
